findings.title: The grant-shortcut matcher rejects the expected shortcut
findings.body: This condition returns `false` when the token ID contains `expectedGrantShortcut`, so events with the correct grant type fail the matcher while IDs with a different shortcut can pass. Reverse the condition; as written, the updated integration assertions cannot verify the intended token IDs.

findings.title: Grant shortcuts are parsed as exactly two characters without enforcing that contract
findings.body: The decoder consumes exactly two characters for the grant shortcut, but `OAuth2GrantTypeFactory.getShortcut()` only documents a shortcut that is usually three letters and the factory never validates its length. A custom grant factory returning a shortcut of any other length will produce token IDs that cannot be decoded correctly, causing token-context lookup to reject valid tokens or resolve the wrong grant. Enforce the two-character contract when registering shortcuts or encode/decode a delimiter-based variable-length value.
